# P02 Document identity and status

- Requirement: Required for all types
- Placement: Document and review records after the body
- Narrative role: Places the document details at the end.
- Author: Document owner
- Reviewer: Document owner and the people who can confirm each status
- Check: Do not turn missing owner information into an assertion that no owner is assigned. Use unassigned only when nonassignment is confirmed. Are the current author, scope, version and status clear? Are previous documents and document IDs linked only when they exist?

## Document details

[Date written and current document version] · Phase: [Phase]. Authoring and receiving sides: [roles]. Document owner: [known owner or assignment status unconfirmed].
